verdict.rationale: Vanta's own pages describe in-product AI that reviews evidence, flags gaps, and suggests fixes (vanta-docs-34, vanta-docs-10). They also describe an AI Agent that flags issues, drafts policies, and completes questionnaires (vanta-docs-15, vanta-docs-36), and agentic search and Q&A across policies, controls, frameworks, tests, and documents (vanta-docs-70). AI-extracted vendor findings and generated questionnaire answers drawn from the customer's own data add further support (vanta-docs-14, vanta-docs-20). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the insights work as claimed, and in-depth documentation of how the suggestions are produced (the evidence is marketing-level only).
